176015.description:
In the near future, the creation of 3D bio-printers has made it possible to regenerate life from a backup. Engineer Haruichi Sono, who works for the world's most advanced tech company, loses consciousness immediately after receiving a sudden transfer order. When he wakes up after being "restored" from a backup, he has somehow lost his memory of the time immediately prior to his death. He is visited by a mysterious beauty, Uro Tonomori, who claims to be an investigator, and she accuses him of insurance fraud for a large sum of money. At the same time, an unprecedented terrorist attack has somehow locked out everyone's memory backups, and Haruichi becomes unexpectedly wanted as the main suspect. Joining forces with Uro, Haruichi attempts to uncover the truth behind his own death to clear himself of a crime he has no recollection of.

But due to her own fetish for pretty girls, she couldn't bring herself to harm the beautiful protagonist she created, and she eventually ends up becoming her protector instead… As she was worrying about her own mixed feelings, the supposedly helpless protagonist pushes the male lead away and insistently confesses her love for Gu Xing instead! One sweltering day, university student Kim Ki-Beom comes home to find Su-Hyeon, a runaway high school girl in front of his house. Trying to be a responsible adult, Ki-Beom attempts to send Su-Hyeon on her way. After discovering she may be hiding a painful past not unlike his own, the softhearted Ki-Beom agrees to let her stay. But there’s a catch: she must leave in exactly two weeks. The clock ticking, Ki-Beom gets to know Su-Hyeon - only to realize that there might be more to his unwelcome houseguest than what meets the eye…

But Abelle’s vice was comparatively tame: having the occasional lewd fantasy. That was until they were all cursed by a witch who sought vengeance on their father. Now, Cecile can’t stop eating, Charlotte can’t stop sleeping, and as for Abelle... Well, she can’t stop craving sex! Maurice is impressed by the gnome's abilities and takes a liking to it. Other painters, however, are opposed to the introduction of gnomes, calling for their ban and extermination for threatening their jobs. Maurice tries to change their minds and protect the gnomes, believing in their potential for good, but he struggles to find a way for gnomes and painters to peacefully coexist.

The master of one dojo, Hachikazu Soudou, a "one-versus-thousand" master of sorcery, is overcome by a sense of helplessness, as he could only hold the hand of his dying childhood friend. That was when a government agent, Shizuku Yabusaki, comes to him with a surprising proposal: "Let's go back to the Dark Ages together!"

One night, he meets Hwa Seo-Yun, a sheep model whose drunken visit leads to Tae-Jun’s first time. While Tae-Jun shyly longs for another meeting, Seo-Yun finds himself drawn to the tiger’s gentle, self-effacing nature. As they grow closer, the two discover comfort and kinship in choosing to live true to themselves.

176074.description:
Higuchi Kiyotaka has hit rock bottom. Once a promising doctor on his way to becoming a cardiovascular surgeon, a traumatic incident has forced him to relocate to a rural town in Kyushu where he's relegated to practicing general medicine. Each day is a struggle to communicate with his heavily accented patients and overcome his intense feelings of guilt and depression. After an evening spent drinking himself into a stupor, he has a fateful encounter with a mysterious yakuza named Tenju, who promises to help the young doctor forget all his troubles for a night. As Higuchi finds himself drowning in unknown pleasures, he can't help but wonder–just who exactly is Tenju? And what does he want from him?

Now stuck with the embarrassing truth out in the open, Phil scrambles to deny it—while women indebted to his hero alter ego keep flocking his way: a saint, a noble’s daughter, even the kingdom’s princess?!

He can live for eternity by making dangerous, but sweet deals with humans who endure hellish lives. To prevent his own extinction, he must protect Do Do-Hee who has taken all of his power.

She died in a final battle, but woke up in the past, the day she entered a portal called “Gate Dragon.” This portal was actually a virtual reality game that took people to a fantasy world full of monsters and dangers. She decided to use her knowledge of the future to survive and change the fate of the world but, she will have to face many obstacles and enemies who tried to stop her, Seo-Ha will also find several allies and friends who helped her on her journey.

At least Eun-Seo has her sweet, shy friend An Jae-Hui in the cast to help her out. But why are no sparks flying this season? And why do the two male contestants only seem to be looking at Eun-Seo?

Along the way Kay begins to realize that there may be far more at stake than just the mythical flower. What will they discover on this perilous journey - and what does Zigril truly want?

synonyms: บุปผาแห่งอโลชยา

title.native: ミッドナイトディメンション

176614.description: Su-hyeon is dating his university senior, Ji-ho, but somehow still feels lonely. Ha-neul, a third-year highschooler who has an unrequited love for Su-hyeon, is always eagerly awaiting his tutoring time with Su-hyeon. One day Ha-neul confesses to Su-hyeon but is rejected since Su-hyeon can only see him as a cute student and little brother. The two of them go back to their everyday lives but as time goes on, Su-hyeon who is stuck in his tough everyday life, and his former student Ha-neul are reunited in a department office he is visiting…

176615.description:
Okunotorishima International Airport has everything for the traveler: a bar, a restaurant, a duty-free store. It even has a special runway that was once built for the Space Shuttle! In fact, the only thing it doesn't have much of is actual travelers, as it's located on a tiny, remote southern island of Japan. That makes it the perfect gig for Okunotorishima's chief—the aviation industry's greatest slacker, Cerezo Shitodoha.

Her love life keeps crashing, and her family relationships are stuck in a holding pattern…so what to do but turn her high-pressure job into a low-pressure one in this tropical paradise, tanning on the runway, chilling at the bar and grill, and teasing the airport's just-as underworked immigration officer. But don't mistake her laziness for incompetence—even if it's an emergency landing of a jumbo jet, rest assured Cerezo will guide your flight safely, wearing flip-flops and bikini bottoms!

(Source: Dark Horse Comics)

title.english: The Sky is but One Roof of the World
title.native: 空は世界のひとつ屋根
title.romaji: Sora wa Sekai no Hitotsu Yane

title.native: 妖怪盗賊マザリシャリフ

176618.description:
Sadameda Souta, a college student who is considered the unluckiest man in Japan, as he constantly draws the worst hands and tiles in every game —Gaining him the nickname of "Million Shanten Man"—, meets and consequently challenges a new student for a game, getting beaten as always. This new student's name is Meronhadake Momomi, a busty woman who has the best luck in mahjong.
After this encounter, Momomi and Souta hang out together, playing mahjong sometimes, meeting all types of people, then later getting involved in affairs pertaining to the competitive mahjong world.

title.native: ミリオンシャンテンさだめだ!!

176619.description:
Yoshioka is a young but talented student living a lonely life, one without parents or friends. He earns money by playing mahjong as a rep player, despite his age; his life is a constant fight for survival!

This is the story of a young man in a dangerous path, one that leads many to destruction; will Yoshioka be able to live on such a risky edge between ruin and survival?
synonyms: 反逆の麻雀 リスキーエッジ

176620.description:
Yo Hinata is an ordinary elementary school student, whose grandfather had gone missing in a tropical island named Carabao 30 years ago, receives an unexpected visit one day, when a girl named Kunie suddenly appears, saying she's from Carabao and that she's his sister! 
Now, as Hinata has to adapt to his new life and help his sister, what'll happen?

176621.description:
The Seo family is cursed with short lives, but Seungjoo seems to defy fate. That is, until a drunken night with his lifelong neighbor, Kim Muheun, changes everything. Awakening beside Muheun, Seungjoo discovers he can suddenly see ghosts. As the eldest son of a prestigious exorcist family, Muheun vows to protect Seungjoo at all costs, even if it means facing deadly spirits. Bound by a deep connection that feels almost predestined, their intertwined fates lead them on a perilous journey of exorcism, danger, and the fight against an ancient curse.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ムフンの夜〜跡形も残らず消えて〜

176622.description:
This manga tells the story of three sisters who are intent on winning a mahjong tournament held every 4 years —The Jan'ou Ketteisen—, where the most powerful players fight for the title of the best player of the world.
This is a story filled with emotions, sweat, tears, and some slight eroticism.

title.native: こんな女と暮らしてみたい

176624.description:
Suzuhara, a Dominant, who runs a BDSM bar, meets Hanamiya, a Submissive, on a dating app.
Hanamiya is a natural airhead who can't be left alone, and that makes Suzuhara can't hold himself back from taking care of him.
Suzuhara, who wants to take care of Hanamiya, gradually closes the distance between them so that Hanamiya won't be creeped out by his not-so-Dominant-like desire...!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Dom wa Kajou ni Sub wo Medetai

176625.description:
Haruyoshi is a high school sophomore dating a junior boy in the Kendo Club. He waits on the balcony today for Ringo, a police officer who moved into the house next door, to "teach" him various things.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 隣にりんごが届きました

176628.description: While in his first year of college, Sagara was half-forced into managing the Travel Circle. Among the circle's many irresponsible seniors, there's one particularly intolerable person. He doesn't come to meetings, he can't manage documents, he plays around, and is sexually loose... when it comes to Vice Representative Yukio, his charm is his only merit. I don't care if a guy like that likes me for some reason..., I hate him, but I can't leave him alone...?

title.native: 大キライな愛されたがり

title.romaji: Mousou Kagaku ADV CHAOS;CHILD: Toaru Joujaku no Kiroku

176641.description:
The youngest girl ever to become a court alchemist, Seyi, was busy with hard work every day. One day, the royal city was suddenly attacked by a horde of monsters, and she woke up 500 years later. The city had already been destroyed, and Seyi, freed from her hard work, was determined to travel through a completely changed world. She was supposed to travel freely, but her potion-making skills quickly become the talk of the town?!

The genius alchemist's leisurely, slow-life journey begins!

title.native: 天才錬金術師は気ままに旅する ～５００年後の世界で目覚めた世界最高の元宮廷錬金術師、ポーション作りで聖女さま扱いされる～

176643.description:
At a certain time every weekday, a certain seat in this cafe becomes a certain freelance consultant's workplace. Katagiri is a man who only breaks out in a grin when he's on the job, but after several encounters with the ever-unpredictable and free-spirited Mita, Katagiri finds himself loosening up a bit...enough to start falling in love. Will Katagiri be able to capture Mita's heart?

(Source: Manga Planet)

176645.description:
Ci Yunye is an unruly yet clever servant at the Gansu Xie Clan. Xie Xiufan, the eldest son, is the only one he respects and fears despite their differences. But when the clan head's new wife schemes to take over the house and harm their loved ones, the two set out to gain power and get revenge on her. As they strive to do so, they find themselves on the Heretical Path, away from orthodox martial arts. Their skills may be called evil and demonic, but Yunye and Xiufan will bring justice with them!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Twin Swords Of The Sima Clan

176647.description:
Kuroha, the author of the monthly manga "Kitakubu Katsudou Kiroku" with its 'full of great boke and tsukkomi' has again created this new work with the same old assessment!

Enjoy the comical journey as the two siblings try to take down the Demon Lord!

synonyms: There are Ghosts on Rainy Days

title.native: 雨の日はお化けがいるから
title.romaji: Ame no Hi wa Obake ga Iru Kara

176651.description: The main character, Maho, is searching for her soulmate, aiming for the ideal love of love and love. But for some reason, I always get caught up in Damens. One day, when she thought she had finally found her ideal partner, she turned into a stalker and something terrible happened... Maho is at a loss and asks for help from Ritsu, a lawyer who is famous for his bad behavior towards women. While living together to protect herself, she ends up teaching Ritsu about true "love"!?
176651.hashtag: #ハイスペ弁護士との同居生活は最低で最高です

title.native: ハイスペ弁護士との同居生活は最低で最高です。
title.romaji: High-Spec Bengoshi to no Doukyo Seikatsu wa Saitei de Saikou desu.

176652.description: A teenage boy who always ends up fighting someone due to his strong sense for justice discovers the joy of playing the piano which enables him to express his bottled-up feelings that are hard to convey otherwise.

title.native: ラプソディ・イン・レッド

176653.description:
One day, Shoto (20), a college student who goes about daily life without much thought, fell in love at first sight with a beautiful woman in his apartment building. However, he was disappointed when he never saw that woman again… until he realized that the plain woman with tattered glasses turns out to be her! Now his usual routine is disrupted by this encounter… A heartwarming pure-love story between an unmotivated college student and a manga artist with low self-esteem!

(Source: Colorful, translated)

176654.description:
Rion goes to an audition just to be able to get close to Kanata, her favorite idol.

While nervously preparing for the audition, she encounters Sakyo, who is in the same band as Kanata! Then, something happens, and she is transformed into a boy...?

A TS x Idol coming-of-age love story spun by a talented author from the TL world!

(Source: Cheese!, translated)

title.native: ヒロインなのに、イケメンアイドル♂になりました!?
title.romaji: Heroine Nanoni, Ikemen Idol ni ♂ Narimashita!?

176656.description: A mysterious high school boy along with his trusted Katana, his Samurai helmet and his school bag stumbles into odd situations where he's forced to slice up ferocious Yokai creatures in bloody battles.

176657.description:
"I... I'm sorry if I don't make you feel good...?"

A girl named Natsuki rushed to take shelter from the rain under an overpass. There she met Kazama, a boy who was her diary exchange partner in the past!

The two of them get into a good mood after opening up to each other while reminiscing about the past. Does he have a girlfriend? Does she have a boyfriend? From that kind of exchange, his lips meet her lips; and spontaneously, he moves his hands over to her chest. They gradually begin touching each other in more and more places...

(Source: FANZA, translated)

Published in COMIC Reboot Vol. 25.
synonyms: Under The Overpass In The Rain

176658.description:
TV stars Rena and Rintarou have been dating behind the scenes for over a year now. When the busy performers finally find time to be alone together, they can’t take their hands off each other!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.romaji: Seijunha Joyuu wa Toshiue Haiyuu ni Amaku Shitsukerareru.

176661.description:
Yeon-Woo's an author but his work isn't going so well and there's the slight problem of his stalker (aka his ex). When he looks for a new place to live, the landlord of the apartment is suspiciously young and way too handsome...but desperate times call for desperate measures!

(Source: Lezhin US)

僕、怪しい者ではありません！

title.english: I Swear I'm Not a Scammer!

176662.description:
Hayato is constantly bullied at school, but the tables turn when his bully suddenly becomes a girl!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: My Bully Turned Into a Girl

176665.description:
The sexual workings of a secret village. ♡

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2022-02

176666.description:
“If I were given another chance...”

10 years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene. Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called “Teller,” but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years!

“Now that it has come to this, I’ll live my best life this time! ”

Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Main Characters That Only I Know

176670.description:
Kaguya finds herself all alone due to her extreme self-consciousness and a careless slip of the tongue. She can't even bring herself to talk properly to her crush. Her only comfort comes from her pet Pomeranian. But then... her pet, who's supposed to listen quietly to Kaguya's woes, suddenly starts chatting away! And to top it off, he's quite the sarcastic one!? Get ready for a heartwarming pet comedy featuring adorable Pomeranian!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

176671.description:
The "Oya Gacha Law," aimed at safeguarding children from abuse, has been enacted. Troubled children are flocking to this opportunity to change their family circumstances. Similarly troubled, the protagonist hesitates to use the gacha. What could be the reason behind this hesitation? Thus begins a tale of "boy meets girl" in a backdrop of despair, where they both feel utterly alone.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

176672.description:
Welcome to the lowest level, known as the "Fourth Layer." It's a place where faith is disregarded and residents are looked down upon by those in the upper echelons. A man eking out a living on the streets is approached by a runaway girl from the upper levels, asking for guidance through the depths of this society. Their unlikely encounter with someone from the upper class ignites a subtle sense of empathy. What decision does the man make in his quest to ascend?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

176673.description:
Weak. Frail. Powerless. That is all Guyeong Oh has ever been, until the legendary Demon Devourer chooses him as its successor. When the Hell Demon opens the Gates of Hell and unleashes monsters upon the human world, Guyeong is thrust into a war he never asked to fight. His only chance to stop the invasion is to devour every demon in his path, growing stronger with each one he consumes. Fortunately for Guyeong, nothing tastes better than monsters fresh from Hell.

(Source: WEBTOON)

176676.description:
Tetsugen Daito is a former Kamikaze pilot. He feels ashamed to have survived the war, which ended while he was in the brig for getting into a fight with his superior officer. The story depicts how Tetsugen Daito survives the chaos of post-war Tokyo with his superhuman karate skills!

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

title.native: 自分のスタイルの良さを分かってない彼女
title.romaji: Jibun no Style no Yosa wo Wakattenai Kanojo

synonyms: 色と欲の裏ワザ剣道 ドンとコイ
Iro to Yoku no Urawaza Kendou Don to Koi

176684.description: Tatsuya Kanno , who possesses both the wisdom of God and the soul of the devil , is the child of an escaped prisoner and the wife of a university professor. Eventually, Tatsuya kills his adoptive father and obtains a huge fortune, and embarks on a spectacular journey where he follows his instincts to commit evil deeds and cruelty.

title.native: 毒舌桃平強いか弱いか!?
title.romaji: Dokuzetsu Momohei Tsuyoi ka Yowai ka!?

176687.description:
There's a 15-year-old who really loves music, especially rock and roll. Not sure why, but he gets that feeling in his heart. Youth, friendship, hometown, glory, loneliness, encounters, farewells, joy, and the essence of life—all of it turns into music for him. This is the tale of a countryside high schooler who dives headfirst into music, risking everything to form the ultimate rock band.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

176688.description:
This spin-off of "The Angel Next Door Spoilers Me Rotten" covers events from the past and present, adapted from the original novel’s volume 5.5, along with the special edition’s short story.

Highschooler Fujimiya Amane just started living alone but already has a strange neighbor. Right next door to him lives the most beautiful girl at school, the "Angel" known as Shiina Mahiru. Their curious relationship blossomed when Amane lends Mahiru an umbrella on a fateful rainy day. Once complete strangers, now neighbors, these teens find themselves gradually drawn to each other.

A collection of sweet, impatient moments of everyday life between a blunt boy and his cute neighbor.

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: She is the neighbor angel, I am spoilt by her. after the rain

title.english: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten: After the Rain
title.native: お隣の天使様にいつの間にか駄目人間にされていた件　after the rain
title.romaji: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken: after the rain

176689.description:
1-4. Kappa Series (河童シリーズ)
1. Kappa no Detekita Hi (河童の出て来た日)
2. Zettai Zetsumei no Hi (絶対絶命の日)
3. Baradarake no Hi (バラだらけの日)
4. Sekai no Mieru Hi (世界の見える日)
5. Tama ni Aru Yona Hen na Hanashi (たまにあるよな変な話)

176692.description:
1. Mahoutsukai no Deshi (まほうつかいの弟子)

3. Star! (スター！)

176693.description:
A society where martial arts warriors dominate the underworld. Heo Pung-gae, a Taoist monk who has been living since the end of the Joseon Dynasty, compulsively practicing good deeds and following the path with the impure motive of not wanting to die of old age at the end of his lifespan, suddenly undergoes a reversal one day... Among extremely selfish people, he loses meaning in the good he does. Will the bragging dog be able to achieve the climb he wants?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

176695.description:
Every day, the stoic black cat, Kuro, diligently follows his perfect routine and enjoys a carefree single life under his owner's care. Despite living a life devoid of sexual desires, Kuro has no complaints. However, his owner worries that he might be lonely and decides to find him a wife. But on a stormy night, instead of a bride, Kuro encounters a cheeky and carefree younger stray cat named Mike.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

176696.description:
After the failure of her first love, Serin easily and quickly falls in love with any good-looking guy. Two days before her birthday, she gets dumped by her hot boyfriend, and her search for a man like the legendary unicorn continues. Little did she know, she'd meet a real unicorn on the virtual reality blind dating app called Random Target. Is this app the golden ticket to finding her true love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count include 3 side story chapters.

title.native: 浄土るる短編集 地獄色

176701.description: Manga adaptation of the novel Moby-Dick by Herman Melville.

176703.description:
With the school festival coming up soon, Tomoki is working hard as a member of the executive committee, but he encounters a snatching incident on the street. With his natural sense of justice, he quickly corners the culprit, but the counterattack knocks him unconscious and breaks his leg. Before he knew it, Tomoki was in a hospital bed, feeling depressed because he couldn't prepare for the school festival, but he was drawn to the bright and friendly nurse Ayana's smile. That night, Tomoki is seen masturbating by Ayana, but instead of being disgusted, Ayana smiles mysteriously and gives him a handjob, saying that it is the nurse's responsibility to take care of a patient. And after that, Ayana's service continues...

(Source: Puchipara Bunko, translated)

Note: includes 2 extra chapters from the special expanded e-book edition.

title.romaji: Moto Yan Kyonyuu Nurse no Ama Ero Kango

176705.description:
A handsome girl and a cross-dressing boy... The perfect (?) fit for the job! The curtain rises on this height-difference romance... ❤

(Source: FAKKU)

Published in COMIC AOHA 2021 Natsu.

176706.description:
A boy finds out that his childhood friend is being bullied by other girls.

He managed to come for her somehow before things got worse, but the girl he saw there was no longer the same old childhood friend that he knew...

(Source: FANZA, translated)

Published in ANGEL Club 2021-01.

176708.description:
Book 14 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

The day Sakuta dreamed about has arrived. Is his search for Touko Kirishima at an end? On stage in front of a live audience, Mai makes a major announcement. So begins the final act of this curious story of adolescence.

(Source: Yen Press)

青春豬頭少年不會夢到摯愛女朋友

Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

176712.description: For more than 2,000 years, there are people who have been waiting patiently to return to the earth. The people of the moon. When the Moonrace, led by the Dianna Counter, began executing their mission to return to Earth, Loran Cehack, who had descended from the Moon to Earth two years earlier, underwent a coming-of-age ceremony. That night, he encountered the Turn A Gundam.

176714.description: My Chiko-tan is a bit of a timid person who gets angry when other cats accidentally enter her territory. She's a good kid who doesn't need to be disciplined, and she knows where to go to the bathroom and where to brush her nails without being taught. But in front of the hospital doctor, Burikko-chan!? She lives a relaxing and heartwarming life at her own pace in an apartment with many cats!

176715.description: Nobara Nonaka's last manga, published posthumously. Much like most of her works, it describes her daily life with her beloved trio of cats.

176717.description:
My ideal type fell in love with at first sight. A guy who kept getting caught and caring about my romance, which seemed to be flat, appeared. Does the legend of classroom No. 201 really work?

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

176718.description: Many stars rise and set in front of the stage, but some don't even have a chance to shine. A youthful romance that depicts the gorgeous backstage, the mixed love of trainees who dream of becoming musicians, and the irresistible temptation and betrayal.

176720.description:
Betrayed by their brethren, a dark elf chief must do whatever it takes to save her people-even trusting orcs.

After their allies violently attack, chieftain Dineru of the dark elves commands her remaining people to flee, leading them into Orcsen, a land of orcs. Despite being enemies, Dineru and her clan are welcomed into the kingdom. Dineru makes a deal with the orc king, Gustav, asking for supplies so she can return to fight, but Gustav has other plans. Fighting alongside the dark elves, Gustav helps lead Dineru to victory and offers them a permanent home in the kingdom. Will Dineru and her people find peace, or is this the beginning of a deadly future?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

176729.description:
Having lost his parents at a young age, Se-Hyun finds his life endlessly miserable. But when he meets Yu-No, a mysterious boy who magically appeared before him, the two quickly find solace in one another. As Yu-No visits Se-Hyun every week, their feelings gradually become more complex as they grow up. With rain pouring down on Se-Hyun's dating life and dark clouds shrouding Yu-No's family life, will they each find what they need once the skies clear? Or will the storm wash away what could have been?

(Source: Tapas)

176730.description: Four girls, "Yoru Mitsuki", an illustrator who stops drawing, "Nonoka Tachibana", a former idol who wants to prove herself with singing, "Nox Ryūgasaki", a self-proclaimed "the strongest" VTuber, and "Kimura-chan", a mysterious composer who wants to support her favourite person, together form an anonymous artist group, "JELEE".
synonyms: Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night

title.native: 夜のクラゲは泳げない

176731.description:
When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.
synonyms: จำเลยหัวใจ

176733.description:
Sho Aiba, the homeroom teacher of Class C, was having a hard time getting his students to listen to him. He especially had it especially difficult with Riko Kishihana, a big-breasted girl, who would provoke him wherever he went, even in the middle of class. Riko's provocations escalated day by day... Eventually, Sho ranned out of patience and crossed a line to make the cocky brat understand...

(Source: DLsite)

How'd you like to taste this...just once?

176739.description:
Miyuki-san is an elegant young lady from Kyoto. But our relationship is complicated. Why? "My, you sure are good at flattery," she says. But were those words sincere? Or just for show? Though we care for each other, we keep talking past one another—a frustrating, bittersweet love story.

(Source: Comic Growl)

176740.description:
Sold into slavery by his own mother, Julian has known nothing but pain and brutality. All that changes when, aboard a slave ship, he experiences the kindness and the tender touch of a loving person for the first time. But fate has plans for Julian in the blood awakening of an ancient god who strikes a cruel bargain: an innocent life in exchange for extraordinary powers—ones he must use to protect a helpless baby in a cruel and violent world!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes:
- Ninth place at the Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2024.
- Second place at the Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2025.
- Won the Daruma Award for Best Suspense/Thriller Manga at Japan Expo in 2026.

title.native: 白黒カノジョができた理由
ザコま〇こセフレの黒崎さん

176743.description:
Drained of life after being sick for so long, Eun-Jae closes her eyes only to open them again as Roella Clemend, the female lead of the web novel she was reading in her final moments. While she may have gotten a second chance at life with a healthy body, there’s a catch. Roella has exactly one year to find “the true male lead” of the story to be able to continue living in this new world. But unfortunately for Roella, this task may be like trying to find a needle in a haystack…

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

title.english: One Too Many Supporting Male Leads

176744.description:
Nobody said being a parent was easy. It’s especially hard for Belphegor Verscios, the adoptive father of an exceptionally gifted human girl who insists on becoming a warrior someday and defeating the Demon King — who, unbeknownst to her, happens to be him. But when you’re a doting father like Belphegor, what else can you do but try to support her dreams while simultaneously making sure she never reaches her goal? It’s a fine line to walk, but he must succeed at any cost, or suffer the worst fate he could ever imagine… disappointing his daughter.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Demon King Dad and his Hero Daughter

176745.description:
People were gathered at a rural hotel for a business orientation, but they were given an unexpected welcome.

(Source: Toomics)

176746.description:
"What is your wish?"

After taking a year off to study for college, Chitose starts avoiding his parents and friends out of shame. One day in a rush on his way to work, Chitose trips over a piece of a wrecked shrine. Days after he says he'd move the shrine to his place if he could, a man in a strange get-up stops Chitose on the street and hugs him...!? "I need you." The man, Amane, claims he's a god and says he's going to move in with Chitose. Chitose caves under the pressure and takes him back to his place, where Amane kisses him and gently pushes him onto the ground!? So starts the odd relationships between two roomates, a rice god looking for a place, and a do-gooder high-school graduate!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Sound of Love in the Sun

176747.description:
The Mist Industrial Revolution ushered in the "Age of the Air." As people move their lives from the ground to the skies, "air pirates" appear, forming cliques and roaming the skies. Among them, there was a pirate who disliked herds and roamed the skies freely, and his name was Huck, an air pirate. The adventures of Huck and his crew in search of treasure and romance begin now.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)
synonyms: Huck the Air Pirate and the Princess of Steam.

title.english: Huck the Air Pirate and the Princess of Steam
title.native: 空賊ハックと蒸気の姫
title.romaji: Kuuzoku Huck to Jouki no Hime

176748.description:
When 29-year-old illustrator Kei quits his job to rethink his future, his editor friend gives him a bizarre request: move in with the brilliant but notoriously difficult 32-year-old novelist Hijiri Saionji to keep him on schedule—and draw his portrait while he’s at it.

With no idea what to expect, Kei travels to the upscale neighborhood and arrives at the doorstep of Hijiri's massive house, only to be met with blatant annoyance and a cold shoulder from the reclusive author. Refusing to back down from this new chapter in his life, Kei resolves to face the prickly writer head-on. But as the two men begin to share a space, Kei discovers there are hidden reasons behind Hijiri’s frozen exterior. Can a stubborn artist melt the heart of a reclusive writer?

A cohabitation BL featuring a novelist with zero social skills and an illustrator rediscovering himself!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Hoshifuru Yoru ni Kikasete yo (星降る夜にきかせてよ)."
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
synonyms: 星降る夜にきかせてよ

176749.description:
A fox and a raccoon living together?! Modern day Japan. A fox and raccoon have been driven into dwelling with humans. Two are chosen to live in the village as humans and protect their mountain. They are: the ever-fighting fox Yugao, and the raccoon, Shitara. Unlike Shitara who finds it to be an awful disaster, the always cold Yugao doesn't seem to agree... "A disaster? Far from it! This is heaven!!!" Yugao's made up his mind to take advantage of this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and be more upfront with Shitara, the raccoon he's always secretly loved. Will Yugao be able to tell Shitara how he feels after years of complicated built-up fantasies!?

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 狐の嫁入り狸の寝入り
title.romaji: Kitsune no Yomeiri Tanuki no Neiri

176750.description:
"I can't believe Hibiki's on stage in that naughty outfit..."

Hibiki works as a bunny boy in a night club where he's reunited with Shun, a classmate from college he secretly had feelings for. Giddy with joy, he drinks himself silly as they reminisce over their time together and before he knows it... Shun follows him into the bathroom and makes a move on him!?

A scuzzy love addict and a meddlesome pure-hearted bunny boy! This is the love story of two men reunited over alcohol, cigarettes, and their memories from college.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Horny monster ❤ Longing for validation!

Happy days spent melting into softness... ❤

176758.description:
Tomoe has an inferiority complex because of his father, who is the CEO of a large corporation, and his outstanding older brother, Wataru. He lives together with his caretaker, Nagumo, away from his family. Suppressing his feelings toward Nagumo, he has lived his life pretending like it was nothing, until one day, when Nagumo told him that he is in love with him. Nagumo and Tomoe's two opposite ways of love will complicate their relationship.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

176759.description:
One day, an unidentified flying object appears in the sky along with unknown insect-like monsters. A normal high school student, Seung-ho Yun, is trying to survive as well as find his family. Along the way, he is aided by a message that tells him the future that only appears in his head. As he moves on with that slight advantage, he finds out that there are others who are getting the same message as him. Will he be able to find his family? And where are the messages in his head coming from?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

176760.description:
Haruki warns a shoplifter and is about to be framed as the culprit, but is saved by Keigo, a customer who is present. After that, Haruki began to meet him often, and Haruki grew fond of Keigo, who was friendly and had a big brother-like personality. One day, Haruki encounters Keigo being assaulted by his roommate Maya. Haruki, who is shaken by the strange atmosphere between the two, but wants to help Keigo, tries to stab Maya in the neck. However, Keigo is far from Haruki's ideal...!?

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

176762.description:
The manga centers on Nazumi, a girl whose recent job has just closed shop, and is now between jobs. After her friend gets her a job at a lingerie store, some customers make fun of her chubbiness, but she is pulled out of the situation by Reo, a former middle school classmate of hers who was once a delinquent.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Lingerie for a Day of Love

title.native: 恋をする日のランジェリー
title.romaji: Koi wo Suru Hi no Lingerie

176763.description:
Reborn as Selonia Bessin, the heroine of a romance fantasy novel, a girl is thrust into a demon-slaying mission with the novel's three male leads. They successfully defeat the demon lord, but Selonia falls unconscious for three months on the journey back. Upon awakening, she discovers the trio is now enamored with Grace Benet, an unknown extra. Moreover, the supposedly defeated demon lord is back in hot human form! Why has he returned, and who is this mysterious Grace stealing the limelight?

(Source: Tapas)

ฉันถูกตัวประกอบแย่งเหล่าตัวเอกชาย
The Male Leads Were Stolen by the Extra

176764.description:
A collection of 12 psychological eroguro masterworks works by Kemo Fujin creator Fujisou
"There's youth, there's craziness, there's creativity, there's mundanity, there's adventure, there's grotesque erotic gags, there's essay. All the entertainment is here...!"
The first half of the book presents 6 previously uncollected doujins,including the iconic Immortal Engine; the second half contains 6 newly drawn works, with guest appearances by fellow doujin artists Neuron Shimizu and Kei Kudo and some diary essays at the tail end.

title.native: 藤想よくばりセット IMMORTAL ENGINE

176765.description: Dramatization of the events who lead to the creation of the live action tokusatsu series Kamen Rider and its multimedia franchise.

The Men who made Kamen Rider

176766.description:
Ai is just a plain old office worker. Only one thing- she's the adoptive daughter of the CEO and looks exactly like her daughter. After this started to get noticed by her adoptive mother, Ai would sometimes act in place of her sister Tokiko. One day, she's sent in place of Tokiko to spend time with Nagare Kuonji, the son of a wealthy entrepreneur, to buy time while figuring out what to do with an arranged marriage proposal. It was supposed to be a simple task to handle while everything gets called off, but it seems like he kind of likes her?? They shouldn't be doing this, but it just gets harder and harder to resist the temptation...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: だったら俺に惚れてしまえ

176767.description:
Akihito is a college student obsessed with looks and sex, but he can't stand the handsome-yet-aloof Sae. Things come to a head when Akihito is shot down at a singles mixer by a girl who's set her romantic sights on Sae. Furious, he follows Sae to the hotel district where he learns Sae's secret: he's gay, and a bottom. Sae confesses he's been having trouble feeling pleasure from sex. Breaking through Sae's mental barriers is exactly the lovemaking challenge Akihito needed. It awakens something in them both. Will they ever be able to control themselves again?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: パーフェクトアディクション

176768.description: An alternate sequel to Kikaider: Code 02. The manga was based on Inazuman chapter "The Boy with the Guitar" and follows mainly Inazuman's story.

title.native: イナズマンVSキカイダー

176769.description:
In a world where hunter rank is everything, Rank F Yun Seo-Ra is lucky to even have a job at the Hunter Association. But when she's trapped in a dungeon, she yells at the system, blaming her inability to escape on her low rank. Out of pity, it offers her an exclusive contract, which Seo-Ra accepts, soaring to Rank S! She begs the system to keep this a secret until she can earn enough money to quit her job. Can Seo-Ra resign with riches, or will her fellow Rank S hunters track her down first?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: Civil Servant Hunter’s S-class Resignation Log

176770.description:
In a world where humans and beastmen coexist, Mashiro, a college student, decides to take care of Kazuki, a beastman who has had no relatives, for a while...

The two actually met once before. Kazuki was looking forward to seeing Mashiro again, but he didn't remember Kazuki at all...
"I was the only one who looked forward to seeing you..."

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title.native: ひだまりの部屋で君を待つ
title.romaji: Hidamari no Heya de Kimi wo Matsu

176771.description:
Souta Inui, who has a timid personality, has a peculiar constitution that causes him to take on the form of a dog if "certain conditions'' are met. Ryo Kurose, a childhood friend who always helped Souta whenever he got bullied, will also turn into a cat if the same conditions are met. The two were separated due to family circumstances when they were young, but reunited several years later.

Souta tells Ryo that he's always loved him, but Ryo doesn't take him seriously at all. Even though Souta declares that it is his turn to protect Ryo, he ends up being saved yet again. People love him when he's a dog, but he wants Ryo to like him as a human too.

(Source: Daitosha, translated)

title.native: ラブベリーラブゲージ

176772.description: The descendants of Holmes and Watson are busting crimes like their forefathers, yet Holmes always manages to get the credit. What is the secret of the great mysterious detective Holmes? And will Watson get the recognition he deserves?!

176773.description: Originally published in Futabasha's "Super Action" magazine.

176774.description:
Just four years ago, Rustica Genas was the most gifted knight in the Caleta Empire and one of the emperor's most trusted servants. But after challenging his will one too many times, all of her fame, glory, and power were stripped from her. Then what can poor Rustica do but shamefully fade into obscurity? Well, when the rival empire's ruler sets his sights on winning her heart and freedom, she might have a chance to reclaim more than just her reputation. What could be waiting for her just beyond the Great Barrier?

(Source: Tappytoon)

176775.description:
A super-elite office worker, Kayahara, does not want to hire any more female housekeepers. Every time he hires, it ends with her confessing her love to him, which is just annoying. And Kayahara does not have good experience with ex-girlfriends. So, when he finds a male housekeeper on the internet, he jumps at the chance to try. Kayahara is pleased to find that the new housekeeper, Sho, is a good cook, and a cat drawing on his message card is so cute. A few weeks later, Sho finds a vibrator under the bed. Kayahara does not know its existence as the toy belongs to his ex-girlfriend. He is embarrassed when Sho hands it out to him, but at the same time he notices something at Sho’s reaction. Kayahara starts to wonder if Sho is a gay. And he starts to imagine that Sho might use that item to masturbate...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 宵闇シュガーキャット

176776.description: Shoko Konokawa, who lost her parents when she was young and now lives alone, is visited by a man who was being interrogated as a suspect in a murder case, but escaped and was led to her. Shoko starts then to gradually get attracted to him...

176777.description: When elephants are about to die, they will leave their herd and die alone. When a person knows that he is about to die, what will he choose? It's lung cancer, and it has already metastasized. There are probably 6 months left. It's a story about a man's last few steps in his life. It's probably quite different from the elephants.

176778.description:
In Korea’s gritty underworld, orphaned street fighter Lee Minjo and gangster-raised Cha Kangchul forge an uneasy alliance, each fighting for survival in a landscape ruled by money, power, drugs, and sex. Both are determined to catch the attention of Kwak Seokhwan, the formidable leader of the Samgeori gang. However, their aspirations are thrown into chaos when a traitor emerges within the organization, igniting a violent struggle for survival and supremacy in a brutal world where loyalty is scarce and betrayal is deadly.

(Source: Lezhin US)

176780.description:
Estelle's life shatters when her family, already resentful of her albinism, abandons her for Seria, who claims to be their real daughter. Left to wander in the cold, Estelle collapses, only to awaken in the care of the House Ballua, the empire's eternal guardians. Intent on leaving after recovery, she finds herself bound by the affections of the Balluas. Unexpectedly, an heirloom arrives from her presumed dead aunt - the lost treasure "Dragon's Tear." Now the heir to the prestigious Mercedes family and the center of everyone's attention, Estelle starts a new life.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 成为了帝国第一继承人
ทายาทผู้ยิ่งใหญ่แห่งจักรวรรดิ

title.english: The Greatest Heiress of the Empire

176781.description: Botchan, a recent graduate, sets out for his first teaching assignment… never anticipating what awaits him. He must contend with students who spy on him and pull nasty stunts and with a landlord who constantly tries to sell him worthless antiques. While on a fishing trip to boost his spirits, Botchan suspects Hotta, his one friend in the village, as the cause of all of his misery. But this is just beginning of his problems…During a meeting to discuss the students’ disrespectful behavior towards Botchan, the proposed punishment is surprisingly mild despite the severity of the acts. Yet, Botchan’s suspected adversary defends him! Were the other faculty members lying about Hotta? Botchan may soon discover the truth, for when evidence of the dean’s activities surface, Botchan and Hotta must team up to corner the dean in his own scandalous game!

title.native: わんだふるぷりきゅあ!

176783.description: A magician uses his skills to solve crimes (and get Ladies).

176784.description:
After a traumatic incident at work, Kamakura locked himself away and let the trash pile up around him, resigned to his fate as a hikikomori... That is, until the day Katsuyoshi climbed in through his balcony. At their landlord's behest, Katsuyoshi offers to help Kamakura clean his apartment, insisting that Kamakura stay with him in the meantime. Kamakura reluctantly agrees, wondering why Katsuyoshi would offer to help out a complete stranger. Turns out, Katsuyoshi has his own reasons— and his own trauma— to work through.

As they tidy together, the pair open up to each other and slowly begin to heal in this sweet slice-of-life romance about moving forward, one trash bag at a time...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.english: The Stranger in the Hoarding House

176785.description:
I've found myself trapped in a mature-rated novel as a cursed cat, whose mere existence is believed to be harmful to the empire. This place has killed every cat in every alley all because of one prophecy... The moment anyone finds me will be my last moment in this life.

"What's this?"

Before I could even think of escaping, the male lead, who's fated to become a mad tyrant, effortlessly snatches me up.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Le tyran et son petit chat

title.english: The Possessive Tyrant and His Sleepy Cat

title.romaji: Maeil Bam Jipchakpokgungwa Jamdeuneun Goyangiga Doeeotda

176786.description: Based on the japanese TV series by the same name.

title.native: ハンチョウ～神南署安積班～

176787.description:
Marlin Trout is an organization established to stop suicides in Japan, where the number of suicides has drastically increased due to the development of social media. Wakame, a slightly airheaded staff member, is constantly pushed around by his uncooperative partner, Umi. They are the strongest team with the best record, but they have a certain "history" together...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

176788.description:
For ten years, Hong Su-Rim has been confined, hidden away by the powerful Baek family. Why? He’s suspected to be “Illishine”, a mythical figure said to bring either ruin or salvation to the clan. On his twentieth birthday, the mark of Illishain finally appears on Su-Rim’s body, and his fate is sealed. He is dragged into the cold world of the Baek family, where he’s placed under the control of Baek Woo-kyeong, the aloof and calculating son of the family head. Su-Rim, having endured years of isolation, has no illusions about love or trust—he plans to use Woo-Kyeong to survive and gain some control over his life. But things don’t go as planned. Woo-Kyeong, at first wary and indifferent, begins to feel drawn to Su-Rim’s strange charm and hidden vulnerability. As the two navigate a maze of family politics, supernatural legacy, and growing attraction, their fates become more entangled than either of them expected. Is Su-Rim truly the cursed savior of the Baek family—or just a pawn in a dangerous game of power and prophecy? In a world where nothing is as it seems, can love be more than just an illusion?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: イリュージョン〜祝福の少年は運命の相手に巡り合う〜

176789.description:
A comedic manga about the adventures of Kamen Rider V3.

Note: Initially ran in CoroCoro Comics from January 1992 until April of 1993 and was later collected into three volumes published by CoroCoro. It was then reprinted in 2004 in two volumes published by Asahi Sonorama.

(Source: Kamen Rider Wiki, edited).

title.native: 仮面ライダーSD疾風伝説
title.romaji: Kamen Rider SD: Kaze no Densetsu

176790.description:
Regret is the bane of old men. When aging Alliance Lord Hajin Cheon of the Grand Martial Alliance reflects on his immense legacy, he finds that he recalls little of his deeds or even the lives of his closest advisors. Stricken by a mysterious ailment, Hajin suddenly passes away only to wake up in the body of Ridan Byeok, heir to the Byeok Clan of swordsmen. The only problem is, Ridan is a well-known wastrel, the polar opposite of the virtuous and stern Hajin. Righting the wrongs of his predecessor, Hajin begins to uncover the truth behind his death…

(Source: WEBTOON)

176795.description:
A comedic take on the Kamen Rider franchise following the adventures of Batta-kun, a parody of Kamen Rider #1, as well as one of the only pieces of Kamen Rider media released during the series' hiatus in the 1990s.

Note: Chapters released from June 1994 to December 1999 in TV Magazine were drawn by Yuji Hosoji and chapters released from 1994 to February 2000 in TV-kun were drawn by Tokio Domon.

title.native: 仮面ライダーSD ばっ太くん
抜きゲーみたいな島に住んでる貧乳はどうすりゃいいですか? コミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Nukige Mitai na Shima ni Sunderu Hinniyu wa Dou Surya Ii Desu ka? Comic Anthology

176797.description:
College student Akane is out at a club with his friends when he runs into Mitsuhisa, an old friend from high school. Akane is an idiosyncrasy guy, so his high school classmates found him creepy and stayed away from him. Only Mitsuhisa hung out with him without fear. Although he can be rude and selfish, Mitsuhisa has a natural charm that attracts other people. Akane felt the mutual attraction, got carried away, and had a one-night stand with Mitsuhisa.

However, for some reason, Akane disappeared without a trace right after their high school graduation ceremony and cut off all ties with Mitsuhisa...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

176798.description:
Their fluids are sweet and become food for humans.
“Shokuyou,” a rare creature whose bodily fluids turn into sweet nectar and are used as food for humans. Although it was thought to be extinct in modern times, they have been living quietly among humans. Haru, who looks just like a human, is actually a Shokuyou. He dreams of the day when someone will accept him as he is, but because of the sweet smell emanating from his body, his classmate and a bully, Shigure, unintentionally recognizes him as a Shokuyou and ends up “eating” him……?
Contains three love stories interwoven between humans and Shokuyous.

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

176799.description:
When his total scumbags of parents die, he finds himself with a mysterious inheritance of 500 million yen.

Deciding to do whatever he likes from then on, the boy enters the most challenging online game, “Dungeon Attack”, where he becomes the first to unlock the achievement of Defeating all the Demon Lords. However, when he answers a mysterious question that appears after completing the game, he suddenly finds himself sent into the game world.

He had been Reincarnated as “Dantalian,” the Lowest and Weakest Demon Lord, Ranked 71st in the game world! With nothing but his memory of defeating the strongest Demon Lord and his eloquence to rely on, he fights to survive in this Brutal World – This is a Story of Comeback and Revenge!

This is it. After having a hopeless crush on him for three years...it's all finally over. Or so I thought.

"I’ve changed my mind. Go out with me."

Three years of rejection, and all it took was one night in bed? Unbelievable. Furious, I walked away…and didn’t look back. But now, that arrogant sunbae has reappeared, asking for my help.

"No need for money. Why don't you convince me with your body instead?"

"Are you sure you won’t regret it?"

"Are you any better in bed now?"

What started as a challenge—payback for the man who once crushed my pride—quickly turns into something far more dangerous. This time, who will be the one in control? Let’s find out.

Yusuke and Ayano have been married for a year.
They want to buy a home of their own… but it would have to be second-hand.
Kids… maybe they can afford one.
Being greedy is no use. They were content with what they had…
The “family image” they envisioned for themselves was “just enough."

Money can really drive people crazy.
A neo-suspense story about the bonds of "family."

(Source: Young Animal Web, translated)

From Miyagi to the bustling life of a Tokyo high school, Machi Nishina wanted anything but the ordinary. Her wish is granted in the most unexpected way when she encounters Oboro Kasumi, a classmate harboring a secret, who ends up following her home...?! A new era of friendship and youthful comedy unfolds!

(Source: Manga Plus)

176955.description:
In a world where the supernatural blends in with regular life, there is an old Japanese house. Living there is a newlywed couple, a human man and a kitsune woman. What can disturb their happy life together… except for a man-eating sparrow?

The daily life between human and youkai is dangerous by day, but sweet by night!?

(Source: Jour, translated)

But to keep intimacy fresh & exciting with such a busy daily life, they try to explore different methods! Filming each other during sex, trying cosplay or going to love hotels! 176958.description:
In his past life, Edmund Cheng clawed his way to the top of "Apocalypse," earning god-tier titles in every class, only to fall one step short of becoming the world's number one. Death wasn't the end. He wakes in a new world, running on the exact same rules as "Apocalypse," except now it's real, and everyone gets one shot at awakening a class. While others are still fumbling through the basics, Edmund already knows every hidden class, every secret path. He's done this before. Now, armed with the glory he never got to claim, he'll forge a path no one has ever walked—and this time, he'll take his place at the top.

(Source: WebComics)

Is my cursed husband's fate up to me?

Madelyn's husband Ian was left broken after the war, and in turn, made her life a living hell. Fleeing her doomed marriage, she meets a tragic end. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself at 17 again. The war has yet to start, and Madelyn can still change her fate. But what about Ian?

(Source: Manta)

176960.description:
A grand adventure, beautiful yet cruel, both within and without.

The boy lost in the witch's forest meets an angel fallen from heaven. A hysterical internal monologue, mixed with the magic of menstruation and the chaos of sexual awakening. The avant-garde artist Kan brings a ray of light to a dark world with his bold and colorful art!

(Source: Books.com.tw, translated)

176961.description:
Karin Kirisaki was raised by a secret organization to be a cold-blooded killer. One day, she was given a mission to kill a manga artist. She was just trying to get the job done, like usual, but then she happened to read Tokimero, her target's serialized manga! It rocked her world and made her yearn for a heartwarming adolescent school life!

Karin immediately quits her job as a hitman, and for the first time, she can enjoy life as a normal high school student, but the organization won't let her go so easily...

A youthful adventure about putting your life on the line, to kill or be killed!
The start of a slice-of-life assassination romantic comedy!

(Source: Shonen Gangan, translated)

176963.description:
Those who die mysterious deaths go on to become legends. All according to plan.

Morality and mortality become intermixed in this action packed thriller that demands the reader to answer the ultimate question: what exactly is worth dying for?

Meet the man with no name as he embarks on a righteous quest to lend his particular set of talents to those in need at a very high cost, the cost of living.

To save lives you must take lives and no one does it better than the Death Architect.

(Source: Tapas)

176964.description:

176965.description:
The cool and capable Kou from Accounting, and Eito, the company's upbeat top salesman, star in a heart-throbbing story of mutual unrequited love! Kou, who's really serious about his job and a bit feared by his colleagues, and Eito, who's being eyed for the next managerial position, are total opposites at first glance. However, unbeknownst to their colleagues, the two are actually close buddies, and Eito stays over at Kou's place all the time. Even though he's already come out as gay, Kou starts to feel restless as their relationship grows more intimate and vulnerable with each passing day. Eito, on the other hand, feels conflicted since Kou's already told him that he's not his type, and that nothing could ever happen between them. A slow-burn romance between two hardworking friends who both yearn for something more!

(Source: Renta!)

176972.description:
Adel, the blind swordmaster, is hailed as a hero for leading his country to great victory in battle. However, he is in despair because he was unable to protect Princess Euphinia, to whom he has devoted his life, from the flames of war.

"I wish I could see her again."

Adel's wish is heard by a higher being, and he is sent back to the past, back when the princess was still alive. However, he is reborn as a beautiful girl...?

The super-cute "Sword Saint," who possesses the powers of both a "Sword Master" and a "Saintess," will weave a tale of heroic rebellion and second chances!

Although she has vowed to live a life of peace, free from all the risks and dangers of the modern world, she just might take her chances with this one.

Tomoya Mitsuhoshi is a 2nd year student in the university drama club. The next script he has to write is for a love story, but he doesn't have any experience in love.

One day, beautiful but amateurish aspiring actor Asuka Fukatsu comes to the club. An idea comes to Tomoya's mind: "...Wouldn't it be nice if Fukatsu-kun became my lover?" Of course, it would only be pretend, but it would help Fukatsu develop his acting skills and get Tomoya some romance experience. When he suggests this to him, Fukatsu approaches with a serious expression on his face...!?

Hiyama is confessed to by Itoi, the prettiest boy in the school, who he's hardly ever talked to. Hiyama spends his days worrying and wondering why he likes him. Then one day, Akabane, Itoi's childhood friend, transfers to their school. Seeing the two of them together makes Hiyama feel depressed... and little by little, his forgotten memories begin to awaken.

That's exciting." Hiroki is drowning in Shishido's non-stop commands. Hiroki thinks he will be forced to be in a play with Shishido, but Shishido does nothing, and Hiroki, unable to resist, begins to ask for commands himself. Hiroki intended to use Shishido just to release his sexual needs, but he finds himself becoming more and more attracted to Shishido's gentleness despite his usual cold personality...

Hikari finds hope in her new life with her four adopted siblings, Mikihisa, Hiiro, Asagi, and Sumire, and the other children at the kindergarten. Noumi Masataka, who’s living the self-indulgent university life, joins a book club after being invited by his professor. There, he meets Tan Eito, an underclassman in the same philosophy department. Eito is serious, openly gay, and utterly unconcerned with other people’s opinions. Combine that with his striking good looks, and Masataka is very much intrigued. He decides to approach Eito, but how will the superconfident junior react to his easygoing senior when they couldn’t be more different?
